notes: v155: (1) Amazon's purchase limit is kept PER SELLER: only the seller Amazon refused is left alone for 6 hours; an offer from another seller at or under your cap is still bought (nothing is locked; Buy again ends it). (2) A purchase starts the moment the buy box has been read - the engine no longer waits for the page to be read to its end (about 1 second sooner on your PC's measurements); the other buying browsers look at the page as it arrives, without fixed pauses. (3) The store-reading browsers start with Chrome's sandbox too. (4) Amazon's offers list is read about twice as often.
